changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE companion_mood ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, companionId BIGINT NOT NULL, energy DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, joy DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, loneliness DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, inspiration DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, irritation DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, createTime TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updateTime TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uk_companion_mood UNIQUE (companionId), CONSTRAINT ck_companion_mood_energy CHECK (energy BETWEEN 0 AND 100), CONSTRAINT ck_companion_mood_joy CHECK (joy BETWEEN 0 AND 100), CONSTRAINT ck_companion_mood_loneliness CHECK (loneliness BETWEEN 0 AND 100), CONSTRAINT ck_companion_mood_inspiration CHECK (inspiration BETWEEN 0 AND 100), CONSTRAINT ck_companion_mood_irritation CHECK (irritation BETWEEN 0 AND 100) );

changeSet.author: li-picture-cloud
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE companion_relationship ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, companionId BIGINT NOT NULL, subjectId BIGINT NOT NULL, familiarity DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, trust DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, closeness DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tacit DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, recentFeedback DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, createTime TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updateTime TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uk_companion_relationship UNIQUE (companionId, subjectId), CONSTRAINT ck_companion_relationship_familiarity CHECK (familiarity BETWEEN 0 AND 100), CONSTRAINT ck_companion_relationship_trust CHECK (trust BETWEEN 0 AND 100), CONSTRAINT ck_companion_relationship_closeness CHECK (closeness BETWEEN 0 AND 100), CONSTRAINT ck_companion_relationship_tacit CHECK (tacit BETWEEN 0 AND 100), CONSTRAINT ck_companion_relationship_feedback CHECK (recentFeedback BETWEEN -100 AND 100) );

changeSet.author: li-picture-cloud
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE companion_memory ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, companionId BIGINT NOT NULL, subjectId BIGINT NOT NULL, pictureId BIGINT NULL, growthRecordId BIGINT NOT NULL, sourceType VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, content VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, originalContent VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, confidence DECIMAL(4,3) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, invalidatedReason VARCHAR(64) NULL, revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, createTime TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updateTime TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uk_companion_memory_growth UNIQUE (growthRecordId), CONSTRAINT ck_companion_memory_confidence CHECK (confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1) );

changeSet.author: li-picture-cloud
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_companion_memory_list ON companion_memory (companionId, status, createTime, id);
